name: com.perfoads/mcp
title: PerfoAds MCP
description: Checks your Google Ads accounts (168 checks) and changes them only after you approve. Self-hosted.

packageArguments.description: Run the MCP server over stdio. Run `npx perfoads-mcp@<version> init` once first to sign in with Google.

environmentVariables.name: PERFOADS_MCP_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Settings folder (optional). Default ~/.config/perfoads-mcp, or %APPDATA%\perfoads-mcp on Windows. Never a folder your AI works in.
